name: Sạt lở / địa hình mất ổn định
decision: If official hazard/field assessment indicates unacceptable risk -> REJECT_OR_ENGINEERING_ESCALATION
ancient_parallel: 疑龍經: 破碎斜傾非吉地
causality_rule: Modern result is independent; ancient phrase is contextual parallel only.

name: Lũ / lũ quét / dòng chảy xung
decision: High/unmitigable flood or flash-flood risk -> REJECT_OR_ENGINEERING_ESCALATION
ancient_parallel: 住宅諸忌: 勿居正當水流處
causality_rule: Hydrology determines safety; cổ thư không thay thế mô hình thủy lực.

name: Gió bão
decision: Use applicable design data; do not infer from compass auspiciousness.

name: Ven biển / nước dâng / sóng / ăn mòn muối
decision: Require coastal exposure design and material durability checks.
ancient_parallel: Thủy pháp may describe form; not a corrosion or surge model.

name: Vi khí hậu
decision: Feeds orientation/opening design; not automatic rejection unless health/safety threshold is exceeded.
ancient_parallel: 宅經/多能鄙事 có ngôn ngữ '滋潤光澤/陽氣' nhưng không đồng nhất đại lượng.
causality_rule: Keep variables separate from traditional terminology.
